fusions.name: Tucked Blade
fusions.desc: Flicks a hidden blade that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Propeller Scar
fusions.desc: A hidden cut that deals 28 damage that ignores armour and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Old Scars Close
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Edge Under the Hide
fusions.desc: Conjures a hidden blade. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.
